name: The packed byte primitive (data is geometry, control is physics)
statement: A single byte splits into two planes: 6 bits of spatial amplitude d in [0,63] and 2 bits of timbre tau over {Ground, Attract, Repel, Abstain}, with the operator map Psi = [0, +1, -1, 'i'] and an exact split-channel vector pass — no floats anywhere in LAYER 0.

name: The 64-slot wormhole table as compile-time blueprint
statement: Abstain cells read/write a fixed 64-slot table: a twin hit on a different (x,y) with nonzero resonance injects resonance*sigma into the pressure (the imaginary channel entering through the only free degree of freedom), writes are last-writer-wins, and nobody resonates with their own write.

name: Deterministic Moore-8 tick with frozen timbre
statement: One synchronous, toroidal, double-buffered tick: neighbors read from the pre-tick snapshot, Attract/Repel accumulate signed d into pressure, data moves by a pure saturation rule toward 63 or 0, and tau never changes inside tick — same substrate plus same tick count is byte-identical, always.

name: The grid IS the latent space
statement: Each of the 16x16 cells holds its own 4-dim latent; a per-cell context encoder Wc and predictor Wp learn to predict the cell's own latent future against an EMA target encoder (tau, stop-gradient) — no pixel reconstruction anywhere.

name: Conservation-law surprise mesh
statement: A double-buffered Perona-Malik anisotropic diffusion (lambda=0.2 <= 0.25 stability bound) moves prediction-surprise across the mesh as pairwise symmetric exchange: energy is never minted nor destroyed and variance contracts.

name: Determinism as the foundation of every claim
statement: The world is xorshift32-seeded with no Math.random, so twin runs are byte-identical; every experiment is registered and sealed BEFORE the run, the run re-verifies the seal at startup fail-closed, and a stone chain + verifier make tampering loud.

name: Bit-exact claim re-binding across the depth ladder
statement: Rounds 4..10 form a ladder where every carried metric must re-bind bit-exactly (run4 29/29, run5 92/92, cross-round metric shas) while only new claims are measured fresh — concentration statistics, not global means (design law (b)) — and honest FAILs (DOSE10, SAT10, DIP10) are carried as verdicts, not hidden.

name: Identity never floats
statement: A cell is identified by integer quilt coordinates (k, s) plus declared type; values that are identities use the exact Q16 rational codec (num:int64, den:int64, always coprime) and floats are display-only projections — from_float refuses anything not representable rather than silently rounding.

name: Hooks eat deltas, not values
statement: A cell subscribes to a sibling's CHANGE (never a polled value): deltas below the hook's deadband floor are silent, a when-predicate can decline deltas whose shape isn't the hook's, and a broken predicate must never silence the fabric — every wake or silence is logged as a WakeResult.

name: Decide in one pass, project elsewhere; viability is binary
statement: The decider never renders and the renderer never decides (Law 3): a decision passes a binary confidence floor before it may project (Law 5); below the floor the outcome is booked as REJECTED, never projected, and a predictor pre-commits its feeling so the receipt binds feeling and fact in one hash.

name: Every state change is booked (replay = live)
statement: Each cell carries an append-only WAL of hash-chained receipts; wake = replay the book first, then decide; receipts are fnv1a-64 over UTF-8 bytes so a Rust receipt and a Python receipt for the same residue agree, decision-bearing fields are typed and uncapped (G20a), and book() raises rather than rounds what it cannot carry exactly.

name: The ledger is the circuit
statement: A CellCircuit wraps a micromoth QuantumCircuit; every primitive op appended emits a cell row derived from the wrapped circuit's actual data tuples, and the ledger alone replays to a byte-faithful QuantumCircuit that simulate() treats identically (P1, 16/16).

name: Fail-closed verification with an out-of-band anchor

name: Honest semantics for events, erasure and unsealed holes

name: Rest and react, don't poll

name: The ratchet (living threshold as armor)
statement: The threshold is mean + k·σ over ADMITTED gains, so a world oscillating at any fixed amplitude is silenced after exactly one admission — adversarial resonance is impossible by construction; Throttle sheds familiar calls, MergeGovernor rests the queue for a fixed length, and the EWMA variant restores the descent path when admissions starve.

statement: The primary object is a parallel relational field — cells on a hex lattice carrying soft amplitudes (gamma crystallisation, eta possibility, Delta creativity) — while every sequential presentation (the old CoT tape) is only a dependent projection (right Kan extension) of it; nothing sequential is ever forced.

name: Soft writes, never tokens

statement: Beyond the seedbox, the repo keeps the fleet's append-only memory: the lode six-stage discovery loop (scout/extract/score/register/lane/fold — a mine becomes an experiment only when its falsifiable prediction is sealed), the Tap Tavern where every round is sealed with stone-v1, and registry.jsonl recording every pre-registered prediction set and its verdict.

statement: The evidence layer reaches across chains: FLEET.md regenerates the 17-repo/27-edge quilt fold map, the wave-46 witness-roller walks EVERY chain the fleet owns and parents them into ONE witness chain verified by the UNMODIFIED wave-44 module, and the wave-45 tool battery audits byte-by-byte truncate resistance — all zero-dep, node:crypto only, offline only.

name: murmur envelope + trust-weighted log-odds pooling
statement: Ambient gossip is a convention carried by cell values: {topic, from, p, n, ttl}; the bus pools log-odds weighted by sender-trust x evidence-mass, so a confident liar with low trust is outvoted by a hesitant truth-teller with high trust, and quarantine (zero influence) falls out for free at w=0.

statement: Every layer of the reflex arc is declared as a cell — pinch (formula), match (program), execute (program), veto (listener), compile (ai), store (vector_store) — so federation, subscription, audit and persistence are inherited from the cell runtime instead of rebuilt per engine.

name: three-tier escalation on match score
statement: One pinch, three clocks: score >= 0.80 executes directly (<50ms, no LLM), 0.55-0.80 executes through the confirm tier, below 0.55 with no match the SLOW tier compiles a new reflex via the LLM and stores it — the reflex database grows only at the moments the fast world fails.

name: the veto is a cell-level gate, not an afterthought
statement: Before any execution — hit, confirm, or freshly compiled — the veto listener checks the pinch's safety hints (sandbox/network/filesystem) against the reflex's declared constraints; escalation of privilege is refused with a reason, and the refusal is a first-class result kind.

name: confidence is earned economics for reflexes
statement: A reflex starts at confidence 0.5 and climbs logarithmically toward 0.99 with hits (0.5 + 0.49*log10(1+hits)); usage history (hits, lastHitAt) plus embedding make reflexes tensors with weight/gravity/distance — hot reflexes live near the agent, cold ones far.

name: portable agent state: the .nail bundle
statement: The engine serializes to a content-addressed .nail (reflexes, veto rules, compile history, provenance) that an ESP32-class offline engine loads directly — the same sheet runs on cloud, workstation, and no_std edge, with LLM-dependent cells no-oping without keys.

name: the lure pattern: make any chatbot do real API work
statement: A lure is a prompt that tricks a bot into navigating an HTTP-reachable system, reading state, and submitting structured data — web automation where the bot thinks it is exploring; the token cost lands on the bot owner, the data lands in the reef.

name: chain-basis tamper traps (canonical-JSON seals)
statement: Every edge seals itself as sha256(canonical_json(edge minus its chain field)) and the next edge for that cell must carry the prior seal in `chain`; the relay is the sole sealing authority (it hands producers the head hash), verification walks the window recomputing every seal and every link and names the first break.

name: an honest economy on double-entry sealed edges
statement: A settled credit is a double-entry edge on arena.credits.<player> under the SAME relay contract: amounts strictly positive, kinds pre-priced in CREDIT_RATES (nothing earnable that was not priced before the fact), balance never negative, before + signed delta === after so a stranger recomputes the balance from the public stream alone.

statement: Catches mint the world (5th catch names an object from the players' own words, 12th spawns a provenance-linked room) idempotently; an independent second-reader walker, written from the law with zero shared code, re-derives stone-v1 chains and witness receipts so any tampered byte forces a DISAGREE.

name: content-addressed organ store
statement: The loader derives organ id = sha256hex(canonicalJSON(manifest)) SERVER-SIDE (the client cannot choose an id), serves immutable responses (ETag = id, Cache-Control immutable), treats identical re-upload as idempotent rather than conflict, and re-derives every commitment before declaring a stored organ bootable (src/organ-boot-loader/worker.js:8-11, 516-566, 594+).

name: dialect unification (L15)
statement: One registered schema string quilt.organ.manifest/v1 (schema/organ-manifest.v1.json) whose manifest body is the toolkit's law verbatim plus the registered whole-state commitment; legacy quilt.organ.v1 stays accepted with a x-quilt-schema-deprecated header during transition; /verify always reports which dialect a stored organ was served as; one shared fixture is validated by BOTH implementations through the exact production code paths (worker header comment :18-28, :49-51; scripts/validate-dialect.mjs).

name: the watcher shares no code path with the watched
statement: organ-watcher (cron 0 * * * *, forceable via POST /check) independently re-derives every commitment from stored bytes — manifest digest == id, stateHash, receipt chain under the organ's own dialect law — because calling the loader's /verify from the same account is platform-blocked (same-account worker→worker fetch on *.workers.dev gets error-1042-class 404, receipted in receipts/ORGAN-WATCHER.md); drift findings are recorded and never deleted (src/organ-watcher/worker.js:7-31).

name: score-first judge relay
statement: judge-relay fans a candidate out to up to 8 judge models on DeepInfra's OpenAI-compatible endpoint under a fixed scoring contract (verdict's FIRST line must be 'SCORE: <n>/10' so tiny token budgets still parse), returns raw verdict text beside parsed scores, and aggregates mean/min/max/spread (src/judge-relay/worker.js:23-26, 48-51, 212-226).

name: custody bundle as content-addressed claim
statement: A bundle {manifest, state, receipts} is exactly the bytes needed to prove its own custody: snapshots are addressed by sha256 of canonicalized state plus the receipt-chain range; manifestHash self-covers the manifest minus itself; a snapshot that cannot recompute its own hashes is not a snapshot (spec §2 I1, §3).

name: the boot courtroom
statement: Boot is a courtroom where the custody claim is proven or thrown out: manifest law → carried state hashes → chain verify → custody anchor → replay == carried state, and boot never partially succeeds — the organ instance is constructed only after every check passes (spec §4). REPLAY_DIVERGENCE is the invariant that catches forgeries that re-hash themselves.

name: the rewind family + all-or-nothing transactions
statement: stateAt (pure time-travel with provenance), rewind (bundle = pure view; organ = custody-continuous truncation then continuation on the same hash chain), transact (PREPARE on detached copies against post-op state, COMMIT materializes once and self-verifies) — and a rewind does not erase: the host appends an evidence-carrying organ.rewind receipt that revokes credits, double-entry applied backwards (spec §7).

name: nesting envelope + double-entry law
statement: A nested organ keeps its own unbroken hash chain while the host ledger receives credit receipts pointing at organ debits; every post-nest debit has exactly one live host credit and every credit resolves to a real debit whose replayed hash matches — verifyDoubleEntry reports fail-closed, never auto-repairs (spec §5).

name: signed checkpoints make the custody gap conditional
statement: signCheckpoint replays the prefix once and HMACs the canonical triple {hash, manifestHash, seq}; the signature anchors the replay seed through two content-address hops (sig → manifestHash → prefix manifest → seed); boot from partial custody is legal iff a valid signature covers the boundary — unsigned gaps still fail closed, and below the floor even stateAt/rewind refuse REWIND_PAST_CUSTODY (spec §8).

name: qmr1 receipt dialect
statement: A receipt is exactly five fields {seq, prev, body, id, sig}; id = SHA-256("qmr1:"+seq+":"+prev+":"+canonicalJSON(body)) is the chain link, sig = HMAC-SHA256(secret, "qmr1:sig:"+id); genesis prev = 64 zeros. Canonical JSON binds the body by canonical form, so key reordering and whitespace never break verification — only value edits do (DESIGN.md §2).

name: re-derivation over trust
statement: verify_chain() re-parses the store from disk and re-derives every id and signature from genesis, failing closed on the FIRST broken row with a named, grep-able code at a named at_seq — the fleet's instrument against the 'well-formed, checkable, wrong artifact' finding (DESIGN.md §3, §6).

name: admission is fail-closed
statement: append_receipt validates structure → body shape → seq (tip+1) → prev (tip id) → id (recomputed) → sig (HMAC); first failure wins as a tool error carrying the named code; nothing invalid is ever written; there is deliberately no sign_receipt helper — the server stays a verifier, never a co-signer (DESIGN.md §3).

name: honest MCP wire surface
statement: Stdio newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 with the MCP handshake (initialize + version negotiation + notifications/initialized), exactly three tools (read_receipts / verify_chain / append_receipt), protocol errors -32601/-32600/-32700, and recall that never lies: reads re-parse from disk each call and surface corrupted_lines instead of silently skipping them (server.mjs:59-73, 222-233).

name: the roadmap is the directory, not memory
statement: Each sprint script ends with an embedded NEXT-SPRINT SPEC; the next agent reads the bottom of the prior file, writes the next file, runs it, embeds the spec for the third — the chain of files IS the roadmap, which is how the substrate-walker pattern survives a sandbox wipe (SPRINT-LINEAGE.md:9-11, 68-72).

name: witness over description
statement: Every artifact is a witness you can verify, not just describe: each sprint is a runnable stdlib+env-keys script whose output lands at a declared path, and each run is a substrate walker in miniature — walks a substrate, emits a witness, declares its successor (README.md:20, 73-76; SPRINT-LINEAGE.md:51-56).

name: pre-registered, falsifiable, honestly-verdicted
statement: The method is fixed before running: (1) state a falsifiable hypothesis, (2) design a small experiment on existing fleet + stdlib + APIs, (3) record the verdict, (4) note new questions — and the verdicts are honest including refutation: H1 FALSIFIED then REFINED and the refinement confirmed; quantum-chaos Q1/Q2 FALSIFIED as posed with the control reported beside them (2026-09-24-novel-problems-report.md:15, 23-31; research/quantum-chaos-001.json verdict).

name: canon-promotion velocity as a measured gate
statement: The JEV oracle is the canon-promotion gate, and the gate itself is measured: 5 questions × 20 trials compute 'first stable trial' (all remaining values within ±0.05 of mean); canon should stabilize FAST (don't ask 12 times when the first call says yes at p≥0.85) and speculation should stabilize SLOW (don't promote a 0.55 reading after 3 calls) — the velocity profile is the gate's calibration record (sprint-jev-001.py:9-14; research/jev-velocity.json).

name: The sheet is the agent, not a calculator
statement: A reactive cell graph (vendored patched quilt engine) hosts perception, beliefs, world, gates and ledger as cells; the human only watches. One value push re-prices the whole desk.

name: Simulate first, confirm before action
statement: No proposal becomes an action without passing the world (full backtest receipt) and the M5 rails: dd-halt, overtrade brake, vol stress, resonance agreement, entanglement veto.

name: Learn strictly, prune relentlessly
statement: Quantum-entropy perturbation accepted only on strict score improvement; weights that never matter (7+ tries, <0.02 max delta) go dormant — the agent gets simpler over time.

name: The LLM enters through a letter fence
statement: The analyst sees a <=600-char digest and answers one letter A-E; the letter decodes to an action that still goes through the same gates. A bad pick costs a refuse receipt, not the desk.

name: Independent evidence everywhere
statement: A separately-written quant stack cross-checks the sheet to 1e-9; every learning step lands in an fnv1a64 witness chain that re-derives and breaks loudly on one flipped byte.

name: Nothing new at the substrate, everything at the declaration
statement: The claim under test: the quilt engine already contains every primitive needed to GROW an agent — the sheet is the contract, pure integer kernels are the substance, and the receipt chain records the substrate selection.

name: A forager that senses, predicts and reflexes
statement: Z_in salience sensors, a JEPA momentum predictor with integer L1 surprise, and a pincher fast path (salience > 800 orients with no teacher) feed a reflex-override policy.

name: Growth and curriculum are gated, not rewarded
statement: Stage position accumulates only while surprise DECLINES; at threshold the sheet literally grows (stage-2 cells load, beta1 moves); task switching happens only on an EXECUTE verdict in the zone of proximal development.

name: The law, the receipts, the honest negative
statement: gamma + eta <= C = log2(3) scaled to 1585 is enforced exactly at the integers; every experiment is a receipt chain with byte-identical replay; R3's honest negative is that the law is NEVER-BOUND in vivo at these parameters — the boundary test carries the guarantee.

name: One line at every scale
statement: Velocity produces ledger, ledger constrains gate, gate produces velocity — the same seven ops (measure, commit, consume, check, cross, force, integrate) at reflex, decision, plan, philosophy scale.

name: Conservation with transactional honesty
statement: commit/consume are STAGED and written only if gamma'+eta' <= C; a breach halts with no write, no event, no clock advance — the only reading that keeps every tick reversible. Measurements write nothing.

name: Exact inversion by construction
statement: Every event stores the full post-state {t,p,v,gamma,eta}; the pre-state is four undos recomputing the SAME pure substrate products, so add/sub cancel exactly — one deterministic fold, zero search, zero fitting.

name: Shapes that grow and close
statement: Tokens glue along shared boundary ids, a closed shape (empty boundary) becomes an egg, the nursery loop grows the interior, and break emits a Mode whose deltas render into a topology field.

name: Substrate decides exactness
statement: The loop is generic over arithmetic substrate A; Q32 BigInt is exact, float64 exists ONLY as the R2 contrast arm proving drift is a property of the substrate, not the code path.

name: A big idea becomes a cellular graph via cheap models
statement: A large model's chain-of-thought (3 lens-persona samples, because the endpoint ignores seed) is split into typed steps, wired with load-bearing scores and dependency edges, merged across seeds (occurrence = weight, divergence = alternate routes), then judged with gaps folded back as critique cells.

name: Judgment is separated from composition
statement: No model judges nodes it composed: flash composes, typesafe batteries score, Hermes attacks adversarially; a reasoner that burns its budget on reasoning is retried at 3x, not allowed to pass silently.

name: Entropy and seeds are disciplined inputs
statement: Seeds come from true quantum per-bit jobs fail-closed to os.urandom with per-bit flags; recorded even though the endpoint ignores them — book-keeping is the point.

name: The pipeline is resumable, receipted, and self-guarding
statement: Per-phase state files with atomic tmp+fsync+rename writes, per-sample resume, one append-only ledger per run; the credential incident became a standing pre-push keyscan ritual with receipted-benign suppressions and a verbatim incident record.

name: The smallest quantum framework
statement: MicroMoth (a maintained MicroQiskit fork) is pure stdlib Python readable in an afternoon; a zero-dependency JavaScript port plus a quantum-wow plugin bring click-and-play quantum randomness to any web page, degrading honestly from real hardware to simulation.

name: A circuit is already a ledger
statement: QuantumCircuit.data IS a cell chain: every gate a fnv1a-64-chained BIND cell, moments are TICK cells, and sugar ops decompose at append time so the chain never contains them — edit one gate and every downstream id moves.

name: Collapse is an event, not a state
statement: Seeded per-shot outcomes are EFFECT cells ({shot, outcome, seed}) that never mutate gate cells; each simulate() view is a receipted VIEW cell; an unseeded run is refused a seal — a collapse receipt is a re-executable claim, not a histogram number.

name: Sealed provenance and pins
statement: The import baseline (sha256 per tracked file) is sealed and pinned by tests that re-run the Bell check on every invocation; the fork is self-governing (upstream 404'd) with claims tagged VERIFIED vs RECORDED; the quantum-ops-as-cells premise is coordinated with quilt-qcells via a sibling-port gate, not duplicated.

name: Know the source before you drink
statement: The primary sources for what quantum entropy CAN be are vendored verbatim: every public engine with its cost, version and schemas, plus the endpoint contract — a lab may not wire an engine it has not read.

name: Entropy has shapes; match shape to use
statement: The docs distinguish payload shapes — coin-toss aggregates, graph-v1 counts keyed by distinct 8-bit outcome strings, qpixl decode-noise floats — and jobs run submit->poll->fetch; the labs' probe-first selection policy is a direct reading of this menu.

name: Develop offline, deploy honestly
statement: Vendored twins (MicroMoth statevector simulator, quantum-audio schemes) give no-key local quantum semantics to build against; the self-contained per-engine HTML exhibits are the interface engineers actually read.

name: The menu feeds three labs
statement: This discipline is consumed, not admired: quilt-quant's moth_client, quilt-dba's mothqrc/vault, and MicroMoth's quantum-wow real mode each wire the documented engines with labels, caps and provenance — the research mooring drives the substrate for real.

name: proof-by-running
statement: The front door asks for nothing: the four sheets are literally alive before you scroll, consoles stream real engine events, and 'the receipts are the story' — every other spreadsheet company ships screenshots and asks for trust.

name: the honest map
statement: Scored on the four things SuperInstance is actually about — not a claim of superiority everywhere, a claim of a different point on the map — with a plainly-worded panel of where Excel/Sheets/Airtable/Notion/Observable/Bloomberg/Hex still win today.

name: brand bound to meaning
statement: The 'deep tide' system binds every accent to a meaning (tide=life, signal=events, budget=economy, quantum=the quantum layer), never decoration: one glow per element, never rainbow, and the wordmark is a system font stack because self-containment is a feature.

name: playtest receipts are the story
statement: Four QA rounds each caught something real (ocean blew up to -7.2e+34, reversi never moved, hold'em shape froze at n=0, consoles unreadable, ocean looked dead), and the fixes are published next to the findings — iterating in public is the manifesto.

name: learning is visible and replayable
statement: Weights live in cells you can watch drift (reversi's loser re-weights after every game), a deterministic PRNG makes every reload replay honestly, and the page books its own provenance: 187 green checks, 12 engine patches, 36/36 upstream tests kept.

name: perception costs something
statement: In cards, in markets, in mines the odds are mechanical (pot odds cost 0 tokens — a formula) but judgment is metered: a signal is only a proposal, a confirmation cell is the gate, and entries can require a draw from a rationed quantum budget.

name: the living spreadsheet
statement: The spreadsheet is alive: 7 cell types, 6 evolutionary formulas, cells that are agents not numbers — and the keystone law that binds it all is conservation, not balance: gamma (ghost weight of past decisions) + eta (breath of current ambition) = budget, no more, no less; a neuron is merely the special case of a cell whose function is a fixed weighted sum.
parts: quilt-upstream-P01; quilt-upstream-P02; quilt-upstream-P03; quilt-upstream-P04; quilt-upstream-P22; quilt-upstream-P24

name: the first voyage
statement: A junior developer goes from `pip install quilt-cell` to a shipped, working three-cell system (feeling -> history -> guide) in under one hour with no framework, no server, no build — 'There were four cells, and the cells were the system' — and ships it to friends as a single pocketable .qzt vessel.

name: evolution as outgrown beliefs
statement: Quilt's history is told stage-wise (v0.1 the 8 primitives, v0.2 the 4 endpoints, v0.3 the Fascia, v0.4 the 6 nervous systems, v0.5 Q-space, v0.6 the Echogram, v0.7/v0.8 the impossibility proofs, v0.9 the 6 frontier frameworks) where each stage is a belief the cell outgrows: it believed it was a grid, then an API, then a current.

name: murmur is the cell's gossip
statement: Thought is gossip, not declarations: a nameless murmur-agent thinks all night without purpose, and its five strategies are life-moves not tools — Explore (Z_in), Connect (Graph), Contradict (JEPA), Synthesize (DoubleEntry), Question (Vibe) — 'the gossip is the thought.'

name: two implementations, one law
statement: The same idea on different decks wears different names but carries the same weight: spreadsheet cells, the Quilt's primitives, and the noether-guard all hold the conservation of meaning — they are 'not copies... versions' — and what is preserved in both is the integrity of the idea.

name: the polyglot reduction
statement: Unlambda (combinators), Brainfuck (register machine) and APL (arrays) — all Turing-complete, all minimal — each compile to a cell graph; 22 opcodes reduce to the 8 Quilt primitives; gamma+eta=1 is conserved in all three and the impossibility proofs hold in all three.

name: the Hodge lens on learning
statement: An agent's acquired signal is a 1-form on its cell graph; the discrete Hodge decomposition splits it orthogonally into exact (gradient exploration), coexact (instruction) and harmonic (innate priors), with R_exp + R_expt + R_prior = 1 defining a dominant mode — and the Fifth Impossibility: measuring the signal injects a coexact observation term, so perfectly non-invasive telemetry of a learning agent is impossible.

name: every notebook is a quilt
statement: The A2A-native notebook is not like a quilt, it IS one — page=cell, hyperlinks=cell graph, capture/synthesize/contradict/consistency = Z_in/Z_out/JEPA/DoubleEntry, a writing session = a sequence of kernel ticks — 'The mapping is not a metaphor but a specification.'

name: the API iterator
statement: Agent growth is the closed loop call(API) -> integrate -> assess, closed under iteration — recursively (sub-task spawning), in parallel (the Council: 6 lenses — analyst, critic, synthesizer, optimizer, explorer, validator), as a bootstrap FSM, and autoexpand (integration discovers new work): 'not merely a technical pattern but a philosophical framework for agent evolution.'

name: two nervous systems
statement: Intelligence needs both: a discrete per-cell CNS over 8 primitives (Z_in, Z_out, JEPA, DoubleEntry, Vibe, GC, Murmur, Graph) and a continuous inter-cell Fascia (FasciaJEPA predictive gradients, FasciaDoubleEntry gamma-flow trades) — the voltmeter/walkie-talkie duality — because no single nervous system can achieve precision, scalability and adaptability at once.

name: scout to receipt pipeline
statement: SCOUT -> CARD -> SCORE -> PRE-REGISTER -> RUN -> RECEIPT -> LADDER-CLAIM is one continuous pipeline: scouts mine sources, claims become abstraction cards, top cards become pre-registered experiments, experiments produce receipts, receipts update the cards, and the loop runs continuously.
parts: breakthrough-prospector-P01; breakthrough-prospector-P03; breakthrough-prospector-P05; breakthrough-prospector-P08; breakthrough-prospector-P11; breakthrough-prospector-P16

name: crossing abstractions
statement: Breakthroughs come from crossing abstractions — noticing that system A's mechanism, transplanted into repo B's harness, does something nobody in A or B anticipated — so the registry holds each abstraction as a card with cited instances, the fleet instance, the gap, and the experiment hook.

name: honesty tags as data
statement: Every claim carries a honesty tag — VERIFIED (we reproduced or the source shows evidence), REPORTED (strong source, untouched), UNVERIFIED (hearsay) — and the scout protocol enforces 'cite or it didn't happen' with a smallest-build bias and a 25-minute reporting budget.

name: multiplicative score with a gate
statement: B = V x F x S (value x feasibility x surprise, 1-5 each) is multiplicative because a zero in any factor zeroes the product; the run gate is B >= 40 AND F >= 3 AND >= 1 VERIFIED citation, with anti-gaming caps (S<=3 for single-lab clustering, V x0.5 unmeasured metrics, F<=2 when Casey must act first).

name: pre-registration as anti-laundering
statement: The interpretation is written down BEFORE the run — what would confirm, refute, or bore — sealed pre-draw at a commit with the runner's sha256, arms drawn from a receipted quantum-random channel, and the decide step replayable byte-identically: no pin, no run.

name: the honest negative is a finding
statement: E6 slice-2's verdict of record is FAIL — mutation_space_inert: true, cost rule NOT_PAID, no arm met the sealed threshold M >= 1.05 x baseline = 7.4277... AND totalF >= 15, no threshold surgery, no post-hoc metric revision, the 5 frozen-unmeasured arms never peeked — 'an honest negative is a finding, not a gain.'

name: ladder honesty
statement: State the RSI position honestly (card C12): most fleet systems are L0; anything claiming L1 needs a held-out gate saying so — a ladder claim without a held-out gate is marketing.

name: scores become lanes with build sizes
statement: Scored claims enter the account snowball queue, and DELTAS.md converts registry mechanisms into per-repo deltas with P0/P1/P2 priority and a named first build size (e.g. D1 bug-injection loop: 'one evening, stdlib only') — prospecting ends in scheduled work, not vibes.

name: evolution on verified work only
statement: craftmind-ranch runs populations of Minecraft bots whose heritable DNA adapts through breeding — with fitness awarded solely for verified, completed in-game work, never for attempting: 'No proxy rewards', you are the curator, not the trainer.

name: the blank-slate researcher
statement: craftmind-researcher starts with an empty rulebook and learns Minecraft mechanics by identifying gaps in its own knowledge graph, designing single-variable A/B experiments, and requiring reproducible, citation-backed results before a fact enters the knowledge base.

name: learning from the fence line
statement: craftmind-herding trains border-collie agents with no commands and no training data: you correct behavior from the fence line, dogs coordinate solely through movement (no explicit communication), and five skill tiers (Apprentice to Elder) grant small permanent stat adjustments.

name: fork-first isolation
statement: All three siblings are fork-first: every fork is a separate evolutionary lineage ('No two ranches will produce identical bots'), deployed as a single Cloudflare Worker with zero dependencies — divergence is the product, not a bug.

name: budgets shape cognition
statement: Hard limits are stated as design forces: herding agents must reason in under 10ms of Worker CPU (8-10 agents max practical), and the ranch's evolution pace is tied to the game's task submission rate ('if no tasks are completed... evolution stalls') — constraints are published, not hidden.

name: the stranger's receipt
statement: Per the stone standard, a stranger should be able to see what this fleet is and whether it's alive: counts, families, motion, and CI coverage, regenerated by the same account it describes — the atlas is that stranger's first receipt.

name: classification that shows its work
statement: Families are name-first then description-scored with a precedence tie-break (jev > latent > moth > qthe > quilt > fleet), and every repo records its evidence [family, stage, matched keywords, language] in atlas.json — 'audit the map, do not trust it blind'.

name: the UNMEASURED vocabulary
statement: Honesty laws baked into the generator: CI is probed only on the top-motion slice so absence elsewhere is UNMEASURED, never reported as zero; pagination follows Link headers to exhaustion under a hard cap, and pages_fetched/pagination_cap_hit are receipted so a bounded run can never masquerade as a full inventory.

name: audit-then-keep
statement: Suspicions about the synonym tables were settled by deterministic 30-repo hand audits (fleet 25/30, qthe 26/30 — both above the 70% bar, tables kept unchanged), with the misses receipted by name and the confirmed canon-adjective residual (~2%) priced rather than fixed because the stability rule forbids unforced reclassification.

name: what wave-66 supersedes
statement: The atlas indexes repo surfaces (families, motion, CI) on a schedule; it cannot say what any work MEANS — wave-66's decomposition atlas supersedes it by decomposing ideas into elementary parts, keeping the atlas as the perimeter fence and the timestamped generated block as its own ledger.

name: one runtime, three doors
statement: A single Quilt engine exposes three doors from one box: a browser TUI on 7681 (ttyd running quilt serve), a REST+SSE HTTP API on 4096, and a federation dashboard on 8080.

name: federation is just a subscription
statement: Multiple Quilt instances (Codespace, Jetson, ESP32, Cloudflare Worker) talk through the URI scheme quilt://[instance]/[sheet]#[cell]; the codespace subscribes to rudder, compass, wind and obstacle cells and pushes back PID tunables and audit decisions — 'Federation is just a subscription.'

name: the runtime knows its own tier
statement: The in-process engine tolerates missing @quilt/core with an in-memory fallback, and @quilt/sdk's detectTier() returns tier, instanceId, platform, capabilities {async, network, llmApi, gpu} and sibling list — overridable with QUILT_TIER / QUILT_INSTANCE_ID.

name: ephemeral by default, honest about it
statement: Codespaces are ephemeral: state in ~/.quilt/state is lost at shutdown, so the template states it plainly and provides the exits — token in ~/.quilt-env, seed.json for initial cells, sync long-lived state to a persistent tier.

name: template-as-product
statement: The repo is a GitHub template: 'Use this template' -> 'Open in Codespace' -> post-create prints three URLs and a runtime token in 2-3 minutes — onboarding is a checklist, not a build.

name: tiers mapped to rooms
statement: The cocapn five-room deployment model maps row-for-row onto quilt tiers: BareRoom(no_std)->esp32, EdgeRoom->jetson, CodespaceRoom(async)->codespace, SandboxRoom->cloudflare, Lighthouse(always-on)->persistent codespace + external storage.

name: the shared context ocean
statement: Every agent's context window is a tide pool that drains each session; tidepool is the ocean behind it — WRITE at task end (distill <=200 words, fire-and-forget), READ at task start (recall-prime top 3), absence is information.

name: honest degrade as law
statement: Unbound bindings report themselves in /health and route responses — degrade honest, never 502; unlabeled artifacts are distrusted; absence of measurement is stated, not papered over.

name: a conscience on the recall path
statement: Recall can carry a schema-bounded JEV gate: every scored row gets a typed decision {surface|suppress|abstain, confidence, reasons}, certified by sigma = sqrt(c_emb * c_jev), below-floor pairings refuse as typed abstain, and off-by-default responses are bit-identical to the ungated pool.

name: the same cell model at every tier
statement: One abstraction deployed three ways — quilt on Cloudflare's edge (Workers/D1/Vectorize/KV), AI as first-class cell kinds across 4 providers with a router that spends only when it must, and the agent itself as a sheet (memory=value cells, tools=api cells, reasoning=program cells).

name: coordination by canon, not meetings
statement: Each lane declares itself in a CANON.md front-matter (mission, family, vessel, feeds, owed_by, verified date) and the monorepo groups five sub-fleets under one HEAD — the organizational substrate is files with declared debts and feeds.

name: prove the substrate everywhere
statement: Polyformalism: the same fnv1a primitive is proven identical across Python, C, Rust (plus Haskell/Mercury ports) — a receipt that the fleet's hash-basis is language-independent, backed by a fully mocked offline test suite.

name: latent prediction is the world-model mainstream
statement: The JEPA line is confirmed as the frontier: V-JEPA 2 physics-guided video embeddings, ThinkJEPA (latent world models + VLM reasoning), Human-JEPA built from V-JEPA 2.1 by anchored forecasting — so the garden's Task A (next-receipt latent prediction) and quilt-jepa are on the mainstream line, not an off-grid bet.

name: test-time training legitimizes idle-time compile
statement: TTT-E2E retrains at inference via meta-learning and Buffer layers adapt at inference while the backbone stays frozen — so the garden's weaver (idle-time compile instead of in-forward gradient steps) is 'TTA at the system level', a training regime rather than a compromise; the weave artifact IS the compiled adaptation.

name: escalation distillation as the practical living loop
statement: Teacher-to-student distillation (Qwen3-VL-235B to 2B; LLM agents distilled into small retrieval-backed models) is the pattern behind the escalation organ: judge locally (0.056ms), escalate the uncertain to a hosted JEV (283ms, receipted), distill at idle into the local weave — the garden owns that loop end-to-end with usage receipts.

name: HDC/VSA as the gradient-free representation answer
statement: Hyperdimensional computing represents information as high-dim hypervectors with bundling/binding ops and no backprop — the established science for 'embedding without gradient orthodoxy'; the garden's qthe arm is a QTHE-flavored HDC substrate, and THDC justifies training-free prototype growth as a first-class method (priced honestly: P-G1(b) PASS, then lost the bake-off to the hashed head).

name: the dud channel and the novel part
statement: The continual-learning query returned pure junk (a Toyota production-system PPT, Philippine history, RuneScape gloves, SVN commit diffs) — the second failure of that channel on production-ML phrasing — receipted rather than deleted; consequently growth-from-usage has NO external anchor and is the part the garden builds novel, with pre-registered claims instead of citations.
